hash_normalization: CRLF normalized to LF before SHA-256
method: Twenty-four synthetic cases across six domains, balanced between irrelevant-detail omission and material-information preservation. Three fresh native executor batch contexts per variant, matched shuffled prompt order per run. Each of three separate native critic agents graded one shuffled version-blinded packet containing 48 responses. Generators received only their instructions and prompts, without criteria or prior answers. One bullet differed between variants. No selective regeneration or candidate revisions.
settings: Native executor and critic role defaults; exact backend routing and sampling settings not captured. Host instructions may influence responses.
experimental_unit: Six generator batch contexts total; responses within a batch share context. The 144 responses are not 144 independent trials.
